title: General Ledger
description: Ledgers, accounts, period balances and journal lines: net movement, opening/closing balance, revenue, expenses, net income; trial balance and journals-to-balances checks.

source.sql: SELECT l.LEDGER_ID, l.NAME AS LEDGER_NAME, l.CURRENCY_CODE, l.PERIOD_SET_NAME, l.ACCOUNTED_PERIOD_TYPE, l.CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID, l.LEDGER_CATEGORY_CODE FROM FUSION.GL_LEDGERS l

tables.name: gl_accounts
tables.description: Account combinations (code combinations) with the account class

ACCOUNT_STRING.description: Segments joined with - (adjust to your chart of accounts)

source.sql: SELECT c.CODE_COMBINATION_ID, c.SEGMENT1, c.SEGMENT2, c.SEGMENT3, c.SEGMENT4, c.SEGMENT5, c.SEGMENT6, c.SEGMENT1 || '-' || c.SEGMENT2 || '-' || c.SEGMENT3 || '-' || c.SEGMENT4 || '-' || c.SEGMENT5 || '-' || c.SEGMENT6 AS ACCOUNT_STRING, c.ACCOUNT_TYPE, DECODE(c.ACCOUNT_TYPE, 'A', 'Asset', 'L', 'Liability', 'O', 'Equity', 'R', 'Revenue', 'E', 'Expense', c.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_CLASS, c.ENABLED_FLAG, c.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS c

tables.name: gl_balances
tables.description: Actual period balances in the ledger currency (one row per ledger, account and period)

PERIOD_END_DATE.description: Last day of the period (links to the calendar)

source.sql: SELECT b.LEDGER_ID || '-' || b.CODE_COMBINATION_ID || '-' || b.PERIOD_NAME AS BALANCE_KEY, b.LEDGER_ID, b.CODE_COMBINATION_ID, b.PERIOD_NAME, TRUNC(p.END_DATE) AS PERIOD_END_DATE, p.PERIOD_YEAR, p.PERIOD_NUM, p.ADJUSTMENT_PERIOD_FLAG, NVL(b.BEGIN_BALANCE_DR, 0) AS BEGIN_BALANCE_DR, NVL(b.BEGIN_BALANCE_CR, 0) AS BEGIN_BALANCE_CR, NVL(b.PERIOD_NET_DR, 0) AS PERIOD_NET_DR, NVL(b.PERIOD_NET_CR, 0) AS PERIOD_NET_CR FROM FUSION.GL_BALANCES b JOIN FUSION.GL_LEDGERS l ON l.LEDGER_ID = b.LEDGER_ID AND l.CURRENCY_CODE = b.CURRENCY_CODE JOIN FUSION.GL_PERIODS p ON p.PERIOD_SET_NAME = l.PERIOD_SET_NAME AND p.PERIOD_TYPE = l.ACCOUNTED_PERIOD_TYPE AND p.PERIOD_NAME = b.PERIOD_NAME WHERE b.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A' AND b.TRANSLATED_FLAG IS NULL

tables.name: gl_journal_lines
tables.description: Actual journal lines with their header (source, category, posting status)

PERIOD_END_DATE.description: Last day of the journal's period (links to the calendar)

source.sql: SELECT jl.JE_HEADER_ID * 100000 + jl.JE_LINE_NUM AS LINE_KEY, jl.JE_HEADER_ID, jl.JE_LINE_NUM, h.LEDGER_ID, jl.CODE_COMBINATION_ID, jl.PERIOD_NAME, TRUNC(p.END_DATE) AS PERIOD_END_DATE, TRUNC(jl.EFFECTIVE_DATE) AS EFFECTIVE_DATE, NVL(jl.ACCOUNTED_DR, 0) AS ACCOUNTED_DR, NVL(jl.ACCOUNTED_CR, 0) AS ACCOUNTED_CR, h.JE_SOURCE, h.JE_CATEGORY, h.STATUS, h.NAME AS JOURNAL_NAME, jl.DESCRIPTION, GREATEST(jl.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, h.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.GL_JE_LINES jl JOIN FUSION.GL_JE_HEADERS h ON h.JE_HEADER_ID = jl.JE_HEADER_ID JOIN FUSION.GL_LEDGERS l ON l.LEDGER_ID = h.LEDGER_ID JOIN FUSION.GL_PERIODS p ON p.PERIOD_SET_NAME = l.PERIOD_SET_NAME AND p.PERIOD_TYPE = l.ACCOUNTED_PERIOD_TYPE AND p.PERIOD_NAME = jl.PERIOD_NAME WHERE h.ACTUAL_FLAG = 'A'

measures.name: GL Net Movement
measures.description: Debits minus credits posted in the periods in context

measures.name: GL Closing Balance
measures.expression: VAR d = MAX(gl_balances[PERIOD_END_DATE]) RETURN CALCULATE(SUMX(gl_balances, gl_balances[BEGIN_BALANCE_DR] - gl_balances[BEGIN_BALANCE_CR] + gl_balances[PERIOD_NET_DR] - gl_balances[PERIOD_NET_CR]), gl_balances[PERIOD_END_DATE] = d, gl_balances[ADJUSTMENT_PERIOD_FLAG] = "N")
measures.description: Balance at the end of the last period in context (adjustment periods excluded)

measures.name: GL Opening Balance
measures.expression: VAR d = MIN(gl_balances[PERIOD_END_DATE]) RETURN CALCULATE(SUMX(gl_balances, gl_balances[BEGIN_BALANCE_DR] - gl_balances[BEGIN_BALANCE_CR]), gl_balances[PERIOD_END_DATE] = d, gl_balances[ADJUSTMENT_PERIOD_FLAG] = "N")
measures.description: Balance at the start of the first period in context

glossary.definition: Debits and credits by account for a period; debits must equal credits
Account balance at the end of a period
glossary.rule: Closing balances are not additive over time - group by period, never sum months

glossary.definition: Revenue minus expenses from the GL
glossary.rule: Revenue is shown positive (credits); expenses positive (debits)

checks.name: GL trial balance balances
checks.description: Debits equal credits for every ledger and month

checks.name: GL journals agree to balances
checks.description: Posted journal lines equal the period movement of each account (months loaded on both sides)

notes: GL_BALANCES rows in the ledger currency with TRANSLATED_FLAG IS NULL are the totals of all entered currencies - confirm on your pod (SELECT DISTINCT TRANSLATED_FLAG FROM GL_BALANCES).
ACCOUNT_STRING joins six segments; edit gl_accounts to match your chart of accounts.
Journal lines reload the last 3 months on every refresh. For history, set the window to 24 months for the first refresh, then back to 3.

title: Payables
description: Suppliers, invoices and payment schedules: invoiced, paid, open, overdue and due amounts; invoices-to-schedules check.

source.sql: SELECT s.VENDOR_ID, s.SEGMENT1 AS SUPPLIER_NUMBER, p.PARTY_NAME AS SUPPLIER_NAME, s.VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE AS SUPPLIER_TYPE, s.ENABLED_FLAG, GREATEST(s.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, p.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.POZ_SUPPLIERS s JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTIES p ON p.PARTY_ID = s.PARTY_ID

tables.name: ap_invoices
tables.description: Payables invoices (amounts in the invoice currency; LEDGER_AMOUNT in the ledger currency)

INVOICE_AMOUNT.description: Invoice amount in the invoice currency

LEDGER_AMOUNT.description: Invoice amount in the ledger currency

PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG.description: Y paid, N unpaid, P partly paid

source.sql: SELECT i.INVOICE_ID, i.INVOICE_NUM, i.VENDOR_ID, i.ORG_ID AS BU_ID, TRUNC(i.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE, TRUNC(i.GL_DATE) AS GL_DATE, i.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(i.INVOICE_AMOUNT, 0) AS INVOICE_AMOUNT, NVL(i.AMOUNT_PAID, 0) AS AMOUNT_PAID, NVL(i.BASE_AMOUNT, NVL(i.INVOICE_AMOUNT, 0)) AS LEDGER_AMOUNT, i.INVOICE_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE AS INVOICE_TYPE, i.PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG, i.WFAPPROVAL_STATUS AS APPROVAL_STATUS, CASE WHEN i.CANCELLED_DATE IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS CANCELLED, i.SOURCE, i.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.AP_INVOICES_ALL i

tables.name: ap_schedules
tables.description: Invoice payment schedules: due dates and remaining amounts

source.sql: SELECT ps.INVOICE_ID * 1000 + ps.PAYMENT_NUM AS SCHEDULE_KEY, ps.INVOICE_ID, ps.PAYMENT_NUM, TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) AS DUE_DATE, NVL(ps.GROSS_AMOUNT, 0) AS GROSS_AMOUNT, NVL(ps.AMOUNT_REMAINING, 0) AS AMOUNT_REMAINING, ps.PAYMENT_STATUS_FLAG, ps.HOLD_FLAG, ps.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.AP_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL ps

measures.name: AP Overdue Amount
measures.description: Open amount past its due date

measures.name: AP Due Next 30 Days
measures.description: Open amount due in the next 30 days

measures.name: AP Overdue %
measures.description: Share of the open amount that is overdue

glossary.definition: What the company owes suppliers: open payment schedules
glossary.rule: Amounts are in the invoice currency - group or filter by ap_invoices[INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE] when there is more than one

glossary.definition: Open schedules past their due date

checks.name: AP invoices agree to schedules
checks.description: Each supplier's invoice amounts equal the gross amounts of their payment schedules

notes: Withholding tax and prepayment applications can make invoice and schedule amounts differ by design - review failing suppliers before treating them as errors.

title: Receivables
description: Customers, transactions and payment schedules: billed, open, overdue, receipts and DSO; transactions-to-schedules check.

source.sql: SELECT a.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, p.PARTY_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, a.CUSTOMER_CLASS_CODE, a.STATUS, GREATEST(a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, p.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS a JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTIES p ON p.PARTY_ID = a.PARTY_ID

tables.name: ar_transactions
tables.description: Receivables transactions (invoices, credit and debit memos) with their total

TRX_AMOUNT.description: Lines incl. tax and freight, transaction currency

source.sql: SELECT t.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID, t.TRX_NUMBER, TRUNC(t.TRX_DATE) AS TRX_DATE, t.BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID, t.ORG_ID AS BU_ID, t.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE, t.COMPLETE_FLAG, (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.EXTENDED_AMOUNT), 0) FROM FUSION.RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINES_ALL x WHERE x.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = t.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID) AS TRX_AMOUNT, t.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL t

tables.name: ar_schedules
tables.description: Payment schedules of transactions and receipts: due, remaining, class

CLASS.description: INV, CM, DM, DEP, CB, PMT (receipt)

source.sql: SELECT ps.PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_ID, ps.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID, ps.CUSTOMER_ID, ps.CLASS, ps.STATUS, TRUNC(ps.TRX_DATE) AS TRX_DATE, TRUNC(ps.GL_DATE) AS GL_DATE, TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) AS DUE_DATE, ps.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(ps.AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL, 0) AS AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL, NVL(ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING, 0) AS AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING, NVL(ps.AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL, 0) * NVL(ps.EXCHANGE_RATE, 1) AS ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_ORIGINAL, NVL(ps.ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING, 0) AS ACCTD_AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING, ps.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL ps

measures.name: AR Billed
measures.description: Invoices and debit memos, ledger currency

measures.name: AR Overdue Amount
measures.description: Open amount past its due date

measures.name: AR Overdue %
measures.description: Share of the open amount that is overdue

measures.name: DSO
measures.expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE([AR Open Amount], ALL('calendar')), CALCULATE([AR Billed], DATESINPERIOD('calendar'[Date], TODAY(), -90, DAY))) * 90
measures.description: Days sales outstanding: open amount ÷ billing of the last 90 days × 90

glossary.definition: What customers owe: open payment schedules
Days sales outstanding: how many days of sales are not collected yet
glossary.rule: DSO uses the last 90 days of billing up to today

checks.name: AR transactions agree to schedules
checks.description: Complete transactions equal their payment schedules for every customer

notes: Line changes may not update RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE; run a full refresh of ar_transactions monthly.

title: Purchasing
description: Purchase orders, lines and receipts: spend, ordered and received quantity, receipt rate; receipts-not-above-ordered check.

source.sql: SELECT h.PO_HEADER_ID, h.SEGMENT1 AS PO_NUMBER, h.VENDOR_ID, h.PRC_BU_ID AS BU_ID, TRUNC(h.CREATION_DATE) AS CREATION_DATE, h.DOCUMENT_STATUS, h.CURRENCY_CODE, h.TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE, h.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.PO_HEADERS_ALL h

SELECT l.PO_LINE_ID, l.PO_HEADER_ID, l.LINE_NUM, l.ITEM_ID, l.ITEM_DESCRIPTION, NVL(l.QUANTITY, 0) AS QUANTITY, NVL(l.UNIT_PRICE, 0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(l.AMOUNT, NVL(l.QUANTITY, 0) * NVL(l.UNIT_PRICE, 0)) AS LINE_AMOUNT, l.LINE_STATUS, l.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.PO_LINES_ALL l

TRANSACTION_TYPE.description: RECEIVE, DELIVER, RETURN TO VENDOR, CORRECT …

source.sql: SELECT t.TRANSACTION_ID, t.PO_LINE_ID, t.TRANSACTION_TYPE, TRUNC(t.TRANSACTION_DATE) AS TRANSACTION_DATE, NVL(t.QUANTITY, 0) AS QUANTITY, t.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.RCV_TRANSACTIONS t WHERE t.PO_LINE_ID IS NOT NULL

measures.name: PO Received Qty
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM(po_receipts[QUANTITY]), po_receipts[TRANSACTION_TYPE] = "RECEIVE") - CALCULATE(SUM(po_receipts[QUANTITY]), po_receipts[TRANSACTION_TYPE] = "RETURN TO VENDOR")
measures.description: Received minus returned to the supplier

measures.name: PO Received in Period
measures.description: Quantity received in the dates in context (by receipt date)

glossary.rule: PO amounts are in the PO currency - group by po_headers[CURRENCY_CODE] when there is more than one

checks.name: PO receipts do not exceed ordered
checks.description: Net received quantity is not above the ordered quantity on any PO

notes: Receipt tolerances can allow over-receipt by design.
RCV_TRANSACTIONS.QUANTITY is in the transaction UOM; compare with the PO UOM if they differ.

title: Order Management
description: Sales orders and fulfillment lines: order value, fill rate, on-time shipping, backlog; shipped-not-above-ordered check.

source.sql: SELECT h.HEADER_ID, h.ORDER_NUMBER, h.SOURCE_ORDER_NUMBER, h.STATUS_CODE, TRUNC(h.ORDERED_DATE) AS ORDERED_DATE, h.TRANSACTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE AS CURRENCY_CODE, h.SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID, p.PARTY_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, h.ORG_ID AS BU_ID, h.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.DOO_HEADERS_ALL h LEFT JOIN FUSION.HZ_PARTIES p ON p.PARTY_ID = h.SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID WHERE h.SUBMITTED_FLAG = 'Y'

tables.name: om_lines
tables.description: Fulfillment lines: ordered and shipped quantity, dates, on-time and open flags

ITEM_ORG.description: Item id - fulfillment org id (links to items)

ON_TIME.description: Y shipped by the requested date, N late, blank not shipped

source.sql: SELECT fl.FULFILL_LINE_ID, fl.HEADER_ID, fl.FULFILL_LINE_NUMBER, fl.STATUS_CODE, fl.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID || '-' || fl.FULFILL_ORG_ID AS ITEM_ORG, NVL(fl.ORDERED_QTY, 0) AS ORDERED_QTY, NVL(fl.SHIPPED_QTY, 0) AS SHIPPED_QTY, NVL(fl.UNIT_SELLING_PRICE, 0) AS UNIT_SELLING_PRICE, NVL(fl.EXTENDED_AMOUNT, 0) AS EXTENDED_AMOUNT, TRUNC(fl.REQUEST_SHIP_DATE) AS REQUEST_SHIP_DATE, TRUNC(fl.ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE) AS ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE, CASE WHEN fl.ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN TRUNC(fl.ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE) <= TRUNC(fl.REQUEST_SHIP_DATE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ON_TIME, CASE WHEN fl.ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE IS NOT NULL OR fl.STATUS_CODE IN ('CANCELED', 'CLOSED', 'SHIPPED', 'BILLED', 'AWAIT_BILLING') THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS IS_OPEN, fl.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.DOO_FULFILL_LINES_ALL fl

measures.name: OM On-Time %
measures.description: Shipped lines that left by the requested ship date

measures.name: OM Backlog Value
measures.description: Value of lines still to ship

measures.name: OM Shipped by Ship Date
measures.description: Shipped quantity by the date it shipped

glossary.definition: Share of shipped lines that shipped by the requested date

checks.name: OM shipped does not exceed ordered
checks.description: Shipped quantity is not above the ordered quantity on any order

notes: Confirm one submitted row per order in DOO_HEADERS_ALL on your pod (change orders keep versions).
IS_OPEN uses common status codes - adjust to your orchestration statuses.

title: Inventory
description: Items, on-hand and material transactions: stock quantity, items in stock, receipts, issues and net movement; no-negative-stock check.

source.sql: SELECT i.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID || '-' || i.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ITEM_ORG, i.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.ITEM_NUMBER, (SELECT tl.DESCRIPTION FROM FUSION.EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL tl WHERE tl.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = i.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AND tl.ORGANIZATION_ID = i.ORGANIZATION_ID AND tl.LANGUAGE = USERENV('LANG')) AS DESCRIPTION, i.PRIMARY_UOM_CODE, i.ITEM_TYPE, i.INVENTORY_ITEM_STATUS_CODE, i.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B i

tables.name: onhand
tables.description: On-hand quantity today (snapshot, reloaded in full)

source.sql: SELECT q.ONHAND_QUANTITIES_ID, q.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID || '-' || q.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ITEM_ORG, q.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID, q.ORGANIZATION_ID, q.SUBINVENTORY_CODE, q.LOCATOR_ID, q.LOT_NUMBER, NVL(q.TRANSACTION_QUANTITY, 0) AS QUANTITY, TRUNC(q.DATE_RECEIVED) AS DATE_RECEIVED FROM FUSION.INV_ONHAND_QUANTITIES_DETAIL q

SELECT t.TRANSACTION_ID, t.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID || '-' || t.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ITEM_ORG, t.ORGANIZATION_ID, t.SUBINVENTORY_CODE, t.TRANSACTION_TYPE_ID, TRUNC(t.TRANSACTION_DATE) AS TRANSACTION_DATE, NVL(t.TRANSACTION_QUANTITY, 0) AS QUANTITY, t.TRANSACTION_UOM, t.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM FUSION.INV_MATERIAL_TXNS t

glossary.rule: On-hand is today's snapshot - it is not filtered by dates

checks.name: INV no negative on-hand
checks.description: No on-hand record has a negative quantity

notes: Item descriptions come from EGP_SYSTEM_ITEMS_TL in the session language.
